en.title: Accessibility Digest: Boomerang Cinema OTT Launch, Allegiant Stadium Honors, Optimum Web3 Integration, and Davanagere GAAD Event
en.summary: Today's top accessibility stories include Boomerang Cinema's global OTT platform aiming to improve access for filmmakers, Allegiant Stadium receiving recognition for its disability-friendly features, Optimum embedding accessibility into its Web3 infrastructure, and a Global Accessibility Awareness Day event in Davanagere that provided assistive devices to participants.

highlights.title: Boomerang Cinema Global OTT launches to improve accessibility for filmmakers
Allegiant Stadium honored for accessibility features
Optimum integrates accessibility into Web3 infrastructure
Global Accessibility Awareness Day Event in Davanagere

zh-TW.title: 無障礙每日摘要：Boomerang Cinema 全球 OTT 上線、阿萊吉安特體育場獲榮譽、Optimum 將無障礙融入 Web3 基礎設施、達瓦納格勒全球無障礙意識日活動
zh-TW.summary: 今日重要無障礙新聞包括 Boomerang Cinema 推出全球 OTT 平台，旨在提升電影製作者的可訪問性；阿萊吉安特體育場獲殘障人士美國退伍軍人協會表彰其無障礙設施；Optimum 說明其去中心化網路將無障礙與效能、可擴展性結合；以及在達瓦納格勒舉辦的全球無障礙意識日活動，為 92 名參與者提供服務，其中 17 名殘障人士獲得輔助設備。

highlights.title: Boomerang Cinema 全球 OTT 上线，提升电影制作者的可访问性
阿莱吉安特体育场获无障碍设施荣誉
Optimum 将无障碍融入 Web3 基础设施
达瓦纳格勒全球无障碍意识日活动
